analysis.overall: A stubborn afternoon spike following a quick low made the day feel uneven, but an evening site change restored stability for a smooth dinner and morning.

events.title: Post-meal dip and stubborn spike
events.description: Glucose dropped to a low of 58 mg/dL shortly after bolusing for 50g of carbs, which then turned into a steady rise peaking at 221 mg/dL despite multiple corrections.

events.title: Site change reset
events.description: Changing your site and insulin helped finally bring that persistent afternoon high back down into range before dinner.

events.title: Smooth dinner response
events.description: A 30g carb meal with a 2.1u bolus kept glucose nearly flat, gently leveling off around 130 mg/dL.

events.title: Extended overnight low drift
events.description: Glucose hovered in the low 60s for an extended period overnight, keeping temporary high targets active until rising around dawn.

events.title: Controlled breakfast rise
events.description: Bolusing 4.3u for 40g of carbs kept your morning rise gentle and well within target range.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Keep an eye on timing for larger afternoon meals to prevent initial quick dips that lead to long, late spikes.
